It states unconverted file-rate access, bypassed channel/mixer/routing/effects, rejected overlap/fades/unknown or nested contributors, zero proprietary executions/runtime comparisons and incomplete full fidelity. The README and structured statuses do not widen admission or promote complete source-track membership into whole-channel/project acoustic equivalence.

execution.reason: Root explicitly requested no execution until GUI inputs were available. gui-inputs.json, gui-observations.json and gui-independent-check.json were absent during this review. Independent Python only parsed AST/data and hashed existing files; no reviewed script code was executed.

full_preflight.reason: Final GUI observations/package baselines/independent GUI review are not yet complete. Root must run the actual final preflight/record/seal, and GUI evidence requires its separate independent review.

limits: This source review does not demonstrate actual sealer acceptance or rejection behavior. The root must execute preflight and acceptance with the final GUI inputs and unchanged script hashes.

GUI group names/count are derived from the independent GUI review rather than hard-coded in the sealer. The GUI reviewer must assess whether the actual groups cover import, complete-track admission, output/gaps, seek/resume/end and rejection behavior; matching metadata alone is insufficient semantic evidence.

The updater writes four live files sequentially after all checks; it is not an atomic multi-file transaction. Original baseline snapshots are preserved for recovery if an external write failure interrupts publication.

The unrelated preserved earlier-session package must remain excluded from QA counts and source publication. A local artifact-manifest hash is custody only and does not authorize uploading that package.
Pinned source/test/GUI evidence remains own-implementation evidence, not Cubase runtime, DAC capture or full scientific/product completion.
